protocol.only_condition_difference: K_212 source; real VNC phase source and all body/engine parameters fixed
protocol.coupling_equation: theta_i[t] = theta_i[t-1] + source_delta_i[t] + g * sum_j K[i,j] * sin(theta_j[t-1] - theta_i[t-1])
protocol.gain_calibration_basis: clean ideal alternating-tripod clock only; no body outcome or condition performance used
protocol.engine: continuous_phase.run_engine / StepGaitEngine.continuous_targets; fixed Path-1 waveform

coupling.edge_scope: both endpoints in io[published_coordination_body_ids], cross-neuromere only
coupling.sign_source: fetch_manc.nt_signs predicted_nt: acetylcholine +1; GABA/glutamate -1; unknown omitted

control_rules.shuffled: permute real signed nonzero K cell values across the fixed real K mask
control_rules.random: independently permute real K magnitudes and signs across the fixed real K mask

criterion.basis: clean ideal alternating-tripod clock only; no body outcome or condition performance used

protocol.phase_definition: analytic phase of band-passed mean flexor-minus-extensor antagonist activity

pre_registered_null: published-cell K_212 is net-synchronizing and does not produce a stable tripod that beats shuffled/random on coherence and feet-planted

continuous_phase.definition: circular phase coherence of continuous per-leg engine phase; canonical tripod groups used only for reporting
